design.protocol: the folds, seed and fitting code of exp_film_level.py (10x5 RepeatedGroupKFold by film, OOF-trained emotions, nested C)

regressors.ridge: standardised, alpha in 10^-1..10^5 by film-grouped 3-fold CV

design.metric: film-level macro-F1 (clip level beside it); film-level ROC AUC mean over genres and repeats; stage-1 R^2 mean over eight emotions, first repeat's outer folds
design.spread: repeat_sd = standard deviation of the ten per-repeat film-level macro-F1 of seed 42; 'stability' = means of five master seeds

stage1_all_clips.protocol: GroupKFold(5) by film, all rated clips, mean R^2 over the eight emotions (as the Stage-1 table)
